audit: GRU hidden-state oracle-accessibility audit spec v1.3

replay_map.identity_extension_F4: The same combined tolerance is applied to the e_P known-coefficient reconstruction.
replay_map.torch_reference: Decoder states and outputs are the float64 CoreGRU.step rollout used by evaluate_arm. CoreGRU.forward (one batched rnn call) is checked as well. Both must agree with the independent numpy float64 GRU to max-abs 1e-10.
replay_map.zero_variance_rule: One rule everywhere: weighted population variance <= 1e-24 (equivalent to sd <= 1e-12). Used for §5 feature exclusion, §9 target variance, and descriptive correlations. Manifest note n1.
replay_map.uniform_weight_r2: The uniform-weight sensitivity uses full-domain uniform-weight Var(q) as the R^2 denominator and receives no meets-floor, below-floor, or BOUNDARY label. Manifest note n2.
